BC_description: Throw an error during Option constructor call for unsupported option flags, such as multiple characters after a single '-' (e.g., '-abc') or multiple long flags (e.g., '--flag1 --flag2'), which were previously allowed but are now invalid to improve consistency and prevent runtime issues.
Adaptation_method: Ensure option flags are valid. For short flags, use only one character after a single '-'. For long flags, use a single '--' prefix followed by the flag name. Example before: new Option('-abc', 'description') or new Option('--flag1 --flag2', 'description'). Example after: Use valid flags like new Option('-a', 'description') for short flags or new Option('--abc', 'description') for long flags. If multiple flags are needed, define them separately or use the dual long option support added in Commander 13.1 (e.g., new Option('--es, --ecmascript', 'description')).
